title: Say Maliket a Balita ed Indaak
intro: Nanengneng mo so sakey a bekta ya ompawil so ilalo. Say sanasawa, ya abayag lan linmabas ed edad na inka-ateng, et akaawat na sipan ya sumlang ed saray ganggan na palsa. Diad pegley da et akaalagey so sakey a pigura ya say mismon kiwawala to et tanda na madibinon panangasi—sakey a kamarerwan nigana parad inkapropeta, ya walaan na tawir ya onlabas ed saray kailalakan. Siopa iyan makatantandan indibidual?
clues: Nianak ak ed atateng ya akasabi lad edad tan anggapoy anak da.
Say inkianak ko et inyabawag na saray anghel ya linma bilang bisita ed pamilyak.
Niiter ed siak so kakabatan tan inkapropeta, tan abitla ak ed limog na saray pasyente.
Say tatay ko et tinawag ya kaaro nen Allah, tan siak so sakey a regalo ed sikato nen wala lad edad to.
Walay agik ya propita met, tan pareho kamin binendisionan na Katawan mi.
Say anak ko et sakey met a propeta, tan saray kabyangay boleg ko so naitdan na kasulatan tan inkapropeta.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
